title: Color is not the same
text: Color is not the same. I'm keeping it because I'm a lover of all things elephant BUT I have to admit I'm severely disappointed in the color.  The seller's photo makes it look like a turquoise/real blanket and it is, in reality, a very blah baby/sky blue with only some turquoise details.  The size is nice and it is both soft and warm, I just wish what is advertised is what I'd actually received.
